ideas.pitch: A high-performance algorithmic duel platform built in C++ featuring real-time socket-based competitive programming clashes.
ideas.title: AlgoDuel Matchmaker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Code Clash strictly forbids AI assistance and limits languages to C++, Java, and Python. A pure C++ high-performance competitive programming platform directly matches the strict no-AI, algorithmic-heavy spirit of the event.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight concurrency and memory profiling tool for Java applications executing under strict time and memory limits.
ideas.title: JavaThread Profiler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges in traditional algorithm and code-focused hackathons prioritize execution efficiency, strict time-limit compliance, and memory optimization.

ideas.pitch: An advanced constraint satisfaction problem solver and interactive visualizer written in pure Python.
ideas.title: PyConstraint Solver Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on hard engineering and rigorous algorithmic problem-solving rather than wrapper applications, aligning with the contest's allowed language set.

ideas.pitch: A secure, sandboxed execution environment for untrusted C++ submissions with automated leak detection.
ideas.title: MemoryGrid C++ Sandbox
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the infrastructural needs of the contest platform itself, demonstrating deep systems-level programming expertise without relying on forbidden AI tools.

ideas.pitch: A modular bytecode disassembler and optimization analyzer for Java class files.
ideas.title: ByteCode Inspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases complex, low-level technical execution that stands out in a hackathon where AI generation is banned and code craftsmanship is paramount.
